beats.spokenText: Sah-skeh doesn't say thank you. At sundown he says, same time tomorrow. From an Oo-chee-hah, that's a speech.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: A week before the final, a clone files a hospital incident report. Patient, Rock Lee. Cause of injury, sand. Eleven witnesses. None of them can say how it moved.
beats.spokenText: A week before the final, a clone files a hospital incident report. Patient, Rock Lee. Cause of injury, sand. Eleven witnesses. None of them can say how it moved.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Boss. The sand moved before he was hit. It guarded him. And the Sand genin's chart says nobody's ever seen him sleep.
beats.spokenText: [uneasy] Boss. The sand moved before he was hit. It guarded him. And the Sand geh-nin's chart says nobody's ever seen him sleep.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Never sleeps. Huh.
beats.spokenText: Never sleeps. Huh.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: He knows one other person who sleeps badly. That night Naruto closes his eyes and walks down into the dark, past the bars, to ask the only expert in the village.
beats.spokenText: He knows one other person who sleeps badly. That night Nah-roo-toh closes his eyes and walks down into the dark, past the bars, to ask the only expert in the village.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Hey, fox. You awake?
beats.spokenText: Hey, fox. You awake?

beats.speaker: KURAMA
beats.captionText: Always, brat. Your snoring echoes.
beats.spokenText: [deep, slow] Always, brat. Your snoring echoes.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: I don't snore.
beats.spokenText: I don't snore.

beats.speaker: KURAMA
beats.captionText: You do. I have twelve years of data, brat.
beats.spokenText: [flat] You do. I have twelve years of data, brat.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: That Sand kid. The sand that moves on its own. Is that like you?
beats.spokenText: [careful] That Sand kid. The sand that moves on its own. Is that like you?

beats.speaker: KURAMA
beats.captionText: Shukaku. A raccoon dog with a sand fixation and no manners.
beats.spokenText: [contemptuous] Shoo-kah-koo. A raccoon dog with a sand fixation and no manners.

beats.speaker: KURAMA
beats.captionText: That raccoon never sleeps because his cage is badly made.
beats.spokenText: [slow, deliberate] That raccoon never sleeps because his cage is badly made.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: What's a badly made cage?
beats.spokenText: What's a badly made cage?

beats.speaker: KURAMA
beats.captionText: A cheap lock. A maker in a hurry, or afraid. The bars don't hold, so the prisoner never rests, and neither does the boy.
beats.spokenText: [low] A cheap lock. A maker in a hurry, or afraid. The bars don't hold, so the prisoner never rests, and neither does the boy.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Kurama is quiet for a long moment. It's the same quiet as a clone reading to him in the dark.
beats.spokenText: Koo-rah-mah is quiet for a long moment. It's the same quiet as a clone reading to him in the dark.

beats.speaker: KURAMA
beats.captionText: Mine was made well. By a man who loved the boy it was for. I hate that I know that.
beats.spokenText: [grudging, almost gentle] Mine was made well. By a man who loved the boy it was for. I hate that I know that.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The next night Naruto finds Gaara on a rooftop at the edge of the village. Sand curls around his feet like a pet that has learned not to be loved.
beats.spokenText: The next night Nah-roo-toh finds Gah-ah-rah on a rooftop at the edge of the village. Sand curls around his feet like a pet that has learned not to be loved.

beats.speaker: GAARA
beats.captionText: Leave. Everyone who comes this close dies. It's the only reason anyone comes.
beats.spokenText: [flat, hollow] Leave. Everyone who comes this close dies. It's the only reason anyone comes.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: I'm not here to fight. I read the report on Lee. The sand moves before you do.
beats.spokenText: [calm] I'm not here to fight. I read the report on Lee. The sand moves before you do.

beats.speaker: GAARA
beats.captionText: It protects me.
beats.spokenText: [flat] It protects me.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: From who?
beats.spokenText: From who?

beats.speaker: GAARA
beats.captionText: Everyone.
beats.spokenText: [cold] Everyone.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: You don't sleep, do you? Because if you sleep, he takes the wheel.
beats.spokenText: [quiet] You don't sleep, do you? Because if you sleep, he takes the wheel.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The sand stops moving. For the first time since Naruto arrived, Gaara looks at him.
beats.spokenText: The sand stops moving. For the first time since Nah-roo-toh arrived, Gah-ah-rah looks at him.

beats.speaker: GAARA
beats.captionText: Who told you that?
beats.spokenText: [sharp] Who told you that?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Nobody. Mine talks too. Mine just reads over my shoulder.
beats.spokenText: Nobody. Mine talks too. Mine just reads over my shoulder.

beats.speaker: GAARA
beats.captionText: Then you're lying, or you're the same as me.
beats.spokenText: [low] Then you're lying, or you're the same as me.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: I got lucky. People walked toward me. Late, but they walked. You got a cage with a bad lock.
beats.spokenText: [honest] I got lucky. People walked toward me. Late, but they walked. You got a cage with a bad lock.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: That doesn't make you the monster. It means whoever built it was in a hurry.
beats.spokenText: [steady] That doesn't make you the monster. It means whoever built it was in a hurry.

beats.speaker: GAARA
beats.captionText: Stop talking.
beats.spokenText: [quiet] Stop talking.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Okay. I can't fix it. I'm not gonna pretend I can. I just wanted someone to say it out loud.
beats.spokenText: [gently] Okay. I can't fix it. I'm not gonna pretend I can. I just wanted someone to say it out loud.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: It cures nothing. Gaara doesn't thank him. But the sand that has moved for him every night for years hesitates for one second, and then it stays still.
beats.spokenText: It cures nothing. Gah-ah-rah doesn't thank him. But the sand that has moved for him every night for years hesitates for one second, and then it stays still.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Naruto walks home with no plan for this one. For the first time in a month, he has nothing filed.
beats.spokenText: Nah-roo-toh walks home with no plan for this one. For the first time in a month, he has nothing filed.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The month ends at the mail desk. One envelope from the Hidden Sand, sealed in wax. It confirms the Kazekage's seat at the Chunin final.
beats.spokenText: The month ends at the mail desk. One envelope from the Hidden Sand, sealed in wax. It confirms the Kah-zeh-kah-geh's seat at the choo-nin final.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Boss, standard form. He's coming. He wants the good chair.
beats.spokenText: [bored] Boss, standard form. He's coming. He wants the good chair.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Read me the signature.
beats.spokenText: Read me the signature.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Soft. Round. Every downstroke curves. Looks like a swan wrote it.
beats.spokenText: [confused] Soft. Round. Every downstroke curves. Looks like a swan wrote it.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Naruto stops. He walks to a drawer, pulls out an old letter filed under S, and lays the two side by side.
beats.spokenText: Nah-roo-toh stops. He walks to a drawer, pulls out an old letter filed under S, and lays the two side by side.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Boss, you said the old one signs like he's stabbing the page.
beats.spokenText: [slowly] Boss, you said the old one signs like he's stabbing the page.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: He did. He pressed so hard the brush split. This man doesn't press at all.
beats.spokenText: [quiet, certain] He did. He pressed so hard the brush split. This man doesn't press at all.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Same name, same seat, same wax. One signature stabs the page. The other flows like water. A man can change his face. He doesn't change his hand by accident.
beats.spokenText: Same name, same seat, same wax. One signature stabs the page. The other flows like water. A man can change his face. He doesn't change his hand by accident.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: He's dead. The Kazekage's dead, and somebody's signing in his place.
beats.spokenText: [barely a whisper] He's dead. The Kah-zeh-kah-geh's dead, and somebody's signing in his place.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: In canon, he's right. Orochimaru killed the Fourth Kazekage and took his chair, and the Sand never knew.
beats.spokenText: In canon, he's right. Oh-roh-chee-mah-roo killed the Fourth Kah-zeh-kah-geh and took his chair, and the Sand never knew.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Boss. That's a head of state.
beats.spokenText: [hushed] Boss. That's a head of state.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: I know. That's the problem.
beats.spokenText: I know. That's the problem.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Should we tell somebody?
beats.spokenText: [small voice] Should we tell somebody?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: We're going to tell everybody. Nobody's going to listen.
beats.spokenText: We're going to tell everybody. Nobody's going to listen.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: He takes it to Kakashi first. Kakashi reads both letters for a long minute, which for Kakashi is a very long time.
beats.spokenText: He takes it to Kah-kah-shee first. Kah-kah-shee reads both letters for a long minute, which for Kah-kah-shee is a very long time.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.captionText: Naruto. I like you. But a signature isn't a body.
beats.spokenText: Nah-roo-toh. I like you. But a signature isn't a body.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: It's the last habit a body keeps. And this one's a swan.
beats.spokenText: [stubborn] It's the last habit a body keeps. And this one's a swan.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.captionText: It's a lovely theory. Nobody will believe it.
beats.spokenText: It's a lovely theory. Nobody will believe it.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: If I'm right, you'll have to explain it to the council.
beats.spokenText: [grinning] If I'm right, you'll have to explain it to the council.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.captionText: And if you're wrong, I'll have to explain you.
beats.spokenText: And if you're wrong, I'll have to explain you.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: He's right. The council hears about it in eleven minutes and laughs for twelve. Only one elder doesn't.
beats.spokenText: He's right. The council hears about it in eleven minutes and laughs for twelve. Only one elder doesn't.

beats.speaker: DANZO
beats.captionText: A boy who reads handwriting. Keep him close, Hiruzen.
beats.spokenText: [cold, even] A boy who reads handwriting. Keep him close, Hee-roo-zen.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: I intend to.
beats.spokenText: I intend to.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Nobody believes a filing clerk about a head of state. Nobody except the old man who hired him.
beats.spokenText: Nobody believes a filing clerk about a head of state. Nobody except the old man who hired him.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: Show me.
beats.spokenText: Show me.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The Third Hokage studies the two signatures for a long time. Then he lowers his pipe.
beats.spokenText: The Third Hoh-kah-geh studies the two signatures for a long time. Then he lowers his pipe.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: I taught that hand its letters. The neatest brush in my class. Never pressed hard on anything, even then.
beats.spokenText: [tired, soft] I taught that hand its letters. The neatest brush in my class. Never pressed hard on anything, even then.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: You know who it is.
beats.spokenText: You know who it is.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: I know who I'm afraid it is. That isn't the same thing.
beats.spokenText: [quiet] I know who I'm afraid it is. That isn't the same thing.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: He'll sit beside you. In front of ten thousand people, in the best seat in the stadium.
beats.spokenText: [tense] He'll sit beside you. In front of ten thousand people, in the best seat in the stadium.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: Protocol. The Hokage sits beside the Kazekage. If I don't, he knows.
beats.spokenText: [mild] Protocol. The Hoh-kah-geh sits beside the Kah-zeh-kah-geh. If I don't, he knows.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Old man. Why are you the one sitting in that chair?
beats.spokenText: [stressing the word you] Old man. Why are you the one sitting in that chair?

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The old man's left hand forms a cross seal on the desk. He still hasn't noticed. Naruto has been noticing for a month.
beats.spokenText: The old man's left hand forms a cross seal on the desk. He still hasn't noticed. Nah-roo-toh has been noticing for a month.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: Who said it would be me?
beats.spokenText: Who said it would be me?

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The Chunin final. Ten thousand seats, every one full, and a village that believes the worst thing today can bring is a bad match.
beats.spokenText: The choo-nin final. Ten thousand seats, every one full, and a village that believes the worst thing today can bring is a bad match.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Sasuke isn't here. Neither is Kakashi. In canon, both arrive late to the final, and the match is nearly forfeited.
beats.spokenText: Sah-skeh isn't here. Neither is Kah-kah-shee. In canon, both arrive late to the final, and the match is nearly forfeited.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Boss. I'm a filing box in the exam office. A proctor just put his coffee on me.
beats.spokenText: [whispering, offended] Boss. I'm a filing box in the exam office. A proctor just put his coffee on me.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: The Sand kid asked about Sasuke's match. The proctor showed him the postponement form. Filed three days ago.
beats.spokenText: [whispering] The Sand kid asked about Sah-skeh's match. The proctor showed him the postponement form. Filed three days ago.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Whose handwriting?
beats.spokenText: Whose handwriting?

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Yours, Boss. Obviously.
beats.spokenText: [smug] Yours, Boss. Obviously.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Nobody can disqualify a boy who has been officially delayed. Naruto filed the form before anyone knew they'd need it. That's what a clerk is for.
beats.spokenText: Nobody can disqualify a boy who has been officially delayed. Nah-roo-toh filed the form before anyone knew they'd need it. That's what a clerk is for.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.captionText: Sorry we're late. A black cat crossed my path.
beats.spokenText: Sorry we're late. A black cat crossed my path.

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.captionText: He made us take the long way around the whole village.
beats.spokenText: [flat] He made us take the long way around the whole village.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Right on time. Technically.
beats.spokenText: Right on time. Technically.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Above them, in the Kage's box, the Hokage and the Kazekage sit side by side. The Hokage smokes his pipe. The Kazekage smiles at nothing.
beats.spokenText: Above them, in the Kage's box, the Hoh-kah-geh and the Kah-zeh-kah-geh sit side by side. The Hoh-kah-geh smokes his pipe. The Kah-zeh-kah-geh smiles at nothing.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Then the feathers fall. White, soft, drifting over the stands like snow. In ten seconds, ten thousand people are asleep.
beats.spokenText: Then the feathers fall. White, soft, drifting over the stands like snow. In ten seconds, ten thousand people are asleep.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Kabuto is the only one still standing. The ANBU assigned to watch him are asleep in the third row, and so is Naruto.
beats.spokenText: Kah-boo-toh is the only one still standing. The ANBU assigned to watch him are asleep in the third row, and so is Nah-roo-toh.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The plan has a hole, and it's exactly the shape of an ANBU squad. Ten squads were meant to hold the gates. All ten are dreaming, and Sound ninja are already coming over the walls.
beats.spokenText: The plan has a hole, and it's exactly the shape of an ANBU squad. Ten squads were meant to hold the gates. All ten are dreaming, and Sound ninja are already coming over the walls.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: On the roof, four violet flames go up, four Sound ninja take their corners, and a dome closes over the Kage's box. The Kazekage removes his hat.
beats.spokenText: On the roof, four violet flames go up, four Sound ninja take their corners, and a dome closes over the Kage's box. The Kah-zeh-kah-geh removes his hat.

beats.speaker: OROCHIMARU
beats.captionText: Hello, Sensei. It's been so long. You've grown old.
beats.spokenText: [silky] Hello, sen-say. It's been so long. You've grown old.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: So have you, Orochimaru. You used to knock.
beats.spokenText: So have you, Oh-roh-chee-mah-roo. You used to knock.

beats.speaker: OROCHIMARU
beats.captionText: This barrier holds until one of us stops breathing. I'd hoped it would be you.
beats.spokenText: [smiling] This barrier holds until one of us stops breathing. I'd hoped it would be you.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: I'm sure you did.
beats.spokenText: I'm sure you did.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The Third Hokage can use shadow clones, and he's been using one all afternoon. It pops.
beats.spokenText: The Third Hoh-kah-geh can use shadow clones, and he's been using one all afternoon. It pops.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: On the next rooftop, the real Hokage feels the whole conversation arrive at once. Jiraiya stands on his left. Four ANBU wait behind him. They've been there since dawn.
beats.spokenText: On the next rooftop, the real Hoh-kah-geh feels the whole conversation arrive at once. Jee-rah-ee-yah stands on his left. Four ANBU wait behind him. They've been there since dawn.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: And Orochimaru is standing alone inside his own barrier. It holds until someone stops breathing. There's nobody in it but him.
beats.spokenText: And Oh-roh-chee-mah-roo is standing alone inside his own barrier. It holds until someone stops breathing. There's nobody in it but him.

beats.speaker: JIRAIYA
beats.captionText: Orochimaru. You always did build a lovely cage.
beats.spokenText: [amused] Oh-roh-chee-mah-roo. You always did build a lovely cage.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: Your barrier is excellent. But a boy read your handwriting.
beats.spokenText: Your barrier is excellent. But a boy read your handwriting.

beats.speaker: OROCHIMARU
beats.captionText: A boy? Sensei, since when do you take advice from clerks?
beats.spokenText: [softly furious] A boy? sen-say, since when do you take advice from clerks?

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: Since one of them started being right.
beats.spokenText: Since one of them started being right.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: It should end there. But Naruto's plan needed somebody awake in the stands, and every awake person in it is a filing box.
beats.spokenText: It should end there. But Nah-roo-toh's plan needed somebody awake in the stands, and every awake person in it is a filing box.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Boss! Boss, wake up! Boss!
beats.spokenText: [shouting, far away] Boss! Boss, wake up! Boss!

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The box can't shout through a genjutsu. But it remembers rule three. A clone that gets hit pops, and he keeps the hit. The only way to hit a sleeping boy is to hit someone else.
beats.spokenText: The box can't shout through a genjutsu. But it remembers rule three. A clone that gets hit pops, and he keeps the hit. The only way to hit a sleeping boy is to hit someone else.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The box drops its disguise, walks out into the open, and lets a Sound ninja put a kunai in its shoulder.
beats.spokenText: The box drops its disguise, walks out into the open, and lets a Sound ninja put a koo-nai in its shoulder.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Ow. Okay. That one's mine.
beats.spokenText: [wincing] Ow. Okay. That one's mine.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The clone pops. In the stands, Naruto jolts awake with a stab in his shoulder and a minute of someone else's afternoon.
beats.spokenText: The clone pops. In the stands, Nah-roo-toh jolts awake with a stab in his shoulder and a minute of someone else's afternoon.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: That hurts. Okay. Okay. Everybody's asleep.
beats.spokenText: That hurts. Okay. Okay. Everybody's asleep.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Forty clones is four batches. That's a four hour headache later. Fine. Fine.
beats.spokenText: [muttering, counting] Forty clones is four batches. That's a four hour headache later. Fine. Fine.

beats.speaker: KABUTO
beats.captionText: Impressive. Nobody wakes up from that. Not even jonin.
beats.spokenText: [mildly surprised] Impressive. Nobody wakes up from that. Not even joh-nin.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: One of me got stabbed. It's a long story.
beats.spokenText: One of me got stabbed. It's a long story.

beats.speaker: KABUTO
beats.captionText: You're a very strange boy, Naruto.
beats.spokenText: [pleasant] You're a very strange boy, Nah-roo-toh.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: He can't wake ten thousand people. But he can wake forty. Every genjutsu report he ever filed says the same thing. Pain breaks it. So forty Narutos run the rows.
beats.spokenText: He can't wake ten thousand people. But he can wake forty. Every genjutsu report he ever filed says the same thing. Pain breaks it. So forty Narutos run the rows.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Sorry! Emergency! Sorry! Sorry!
beats.spokenText: [running, slapping] Sorry! Emergency! Sorry! Sorry!

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.captionText: Naruto? Did you just slap me?
beats.spokenText: [groggy] Nah-roo-toh? Did you just slap me?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Sorry, sensei! It was an emergency!
beats.spokenText: Sorry, sen-say! It was an emergency!

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.captionText: Then go! I'll take the left side!
beats.spokenText: [snapping awake] Then go! I'll take the left side!

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.captionText: Naruto, you slapped me!
beats.spokenText: Nah-roo-toh, you slapped me!

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: You were asleep! It counts as medicine!
beats.spokenText: You were asleep! It counts as medicine!

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Kabuto doesn't fight a boy with forty witnesses. He's gone before the third slap.
beats.spokenText: Kah-boo-toh doesn't fight a boy with forty witnesses. He's gone before the third slap.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Ten squads wake up angry and head for the gates, and two late arrivals head for them faster.
beats.spokenText: Ten squads wake up angry and head for the gates, and two late arrivals head for them faster.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.captionText: Sasuke, east gate. I'll take the west one.
beats.spokenText: Sah-skeh, east gate. I'll take the west one.

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.captionText: Try not to be late.
beats.spokenText: Try not to be late.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.captionText: I'm already here. Give me some credit.
beats.spokenText: I'm already here. Give me some credit.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: And in the middle of the arena, Gaara stands alone. The sand is up. It isn't moving.
beats.spokenText: And in the middle of the arena, Gah-ah-rah stands alone. The sand is up. It isn't moving.

beats.speaker: GAARA
beats.captionText: The man in the white hat gave the order. He said he was my father.
beats.spokenText: [flat] The man in the white hat gave the order. He said he was my father.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: He wasn't. I've got the handwriting. I'm sorry.
beats.spokenText: He wasn't. I've got the handwriting. I'm sorry.

beats.speaker: GAARA
beats.captionText: Then who has been giving the orders?
beats.spokenText: [low] Then who has been giving the orders?

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Naruto doesn't have an answer the boy would believe. The sand rises, then lowers. It cures nothing. But it doesn't go for Naruto, and it doesn't go for the village. After a while, Gaara just leaves.
beats.spokenText: Nah-roo-toh doesn't have an answer the boy would believe. The sand rises, then lowers. It cures nothing. But it doesn't go for Nah-roo-toh, and it doesn't go for the village. After a while, Gah-ah-rah just leaves.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: On the roof, the Sound Four have to drop their own barrier to let their master out. The moment it falls, Orochimaru is fighting his old teacher and his old teammate at once. He loses ground every minute.
beats.spokenText: On the roof, the Sound Four have to drop their own barrier to let their master out. The moment it falls, Oh-roh-chee-mah-roo is fighting his old teacher and his old teammate at once. He loses ground every minute.

beats.speaker: OROCHIMARU
beats.captionText: Who wrote this plan, Sensei? It isn't yours. It's far too tidy.
beats.spokenText: [cold, curious] Who wrote this plan, sen-say? It isn't yours. It's far too tidy.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: A clerk.
beats.spokenText: A clerk.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Orochimaru does what he has always done when a plan goes wrong. He leaves. He keeps his arms. Hiruzen lets him go, because the village needs its Hokage more than it needs a grudge.
beats.spokenText: Oh-roh-chee-mah-roo does what he has always done when a plan goes wrong. He leaves. He keeps his arms. Hee-roo-zen lets him go, because the village needs its Hoh-kah-geh more than it needs a grudge.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The Sand shinobi hold their line for an hour. Then word spreads that the Kazekage's chair held a stranger, and they have no reason left to be here. By dusk, the invasion is over. It lasted one afternoon.
beats.spokenText: The Sand shee-noh-bee hold their line for an hour. Then word spreads that the Kah-zeh-kah-geh's chair held a stranger, and they have no reason left to be here. By dusk, the invasion is over. It lasted one afternoon.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: In canon, the Third Hokage dies on that roof. Tonight he's in a hospital bed with a stitched shoulder, a burned sleeve, and strong opinions about the soup.
beats.spokenText: In canon, the Third Hoh-kah-geh dies on that roof. Tonight he's in a hospital bed with a stitched shoulder, a burned sleeve, and strong opinions about the soup.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Old man. You're alive.
beats.spokenText: Old man. You're alive.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: So I'm told. I'd like it noted that I planned this.
beats.spokenText: [dry] So I'm told. I'd like it noted that I planned this.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: You did not. I planned this.
beats.spokenText: You did not. I planned this.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: Then I'd like it noted that I approved it.
beats.spokenText: Then I'd like it noted that I approved it.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: Naruto. Tell the village I'm fine. Tell them the soup is a crime.
beats.spokenText: [weary, amused] Nah-roo-toh. Tell the village I'm fine. Tell them the soup is a crime.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Naruto's reward is paperwork. The aftermath of the invasion. Eleven thousand pages, one night, forty clones.
beats.spokenText: Nah-roo-toh's reward is paperwork. The aftermath of the invasion. Eleven thousand pages, one night, forty clones.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: He doesn't mind. Paper is the only thing in this village that has never lied to him.
beats.spokenText: He doesn't mind. Paper is the only thing in this village that has never lied to him.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: At two in the morning, it does. A gap on the shelf marked Uchiha. Not a missing file. A missing order.
beats.spokenText: At two in the morning, it does. A gap on the shelf marked Oo-chee-hah. Not a missing file. A missing order.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Boss. The night the Uchiha clan died. There's no mission order for it. Nothing at all.
beats.spokenText: [hushed] Boss. The night the Oo-chee-hah clan died. There's no mission order for it. Nothing at all.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Somebody gave an order. Somebody always gives an order.
beats.spokenText: Somebody gave an order. Somebody always gives an order.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: There's a leave slip, though. One ANBU captain, signed out for the night. Look who countersigned it.
beats.spokenText: [hushed] There's a leave slip, though. One ANBU captain, signed out for the night. Look who countersigned it.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: A leave slip for the night the Uchiha clan died. And at the bottom, in a hand he has seen across a council table, one countersignature.
beats.spokenText: A leave slip for the night the Oo-chee-hah clan died. And at the bottom, in a hand he has seen across a council table, one countersignature.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Boss. It says Danzo.
beats.spokenText: [barely audible] Boss. It says Dahn-zoh.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Don't say it twice.
beats.spokenText: Don't say it twice.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: He looks up. Naruto knows everyone in this village by their footsteps. He didn't hear these.
beats.spokenText: He looks up. Nah-roo-toh knows everyone in this village by their footsteps. He didn't hear these.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: How long have you been standing there?
beats.spokenText: How long have you been standing there?

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.captionText: Long enough.
beats.spokenText: Long enough.
